newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices recover on consumer buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices recover on consumer buying.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Thursday recovered from recent losses on fresh consumer buying, dealers said.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 moved up by 5/15 rupees at 1,250/1,295 rupees per quintal while M-30 rose by five rupees at 1,285/1,350 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery bounced back to 1,180/1,205 rupees from 1,175/1,180 rupees.
"Offerings by millers remained low which in turn eased the pressure on supplies from mills to the Bombay market," one broker said.
"Sugar mill delivery also looked up on the back of fresh demand from the bulk consumers as well as from the outstation buyers," he added.
Overall sentiment was firm at the close and traders were expecting prices to look up further from the current level.
